english: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God, who, according to the will of thy Father, hast by thy death, thro' the co-operation of the Holy Ghost, given life to the world, deliver me by this thy most sacred body and blood from all my iniquities, and from all evils; and make me always adhere to thy commandments, and never suffer me to be separated from thee:
notes: Exact source prefix through the colon before the separate old conclusion; punctuation is unchanged.

english: who livest and reignest with God the Father, &c. Amen.
notes: Complete remaining old conclusion retained as source apparatus, not joined to the modern preparation prayer.
